author: chris
text:
Florida Atlantic's Cybersecurity Club at the College of Engineering and Computer Science has a guest speaker coming this Tuesday: Carlos Roqué, Technology Advisor at the White House and Product Lead at College Board.

Carlos previously led product teams at the White House and has worked at the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, Facebook, and Magic Leap. He'll talk about how to find and land government tech internships, fellowships, and full-time roles, with Q&A to follow. Don't miss it!

 Engineering East, Room 405
 November 17th from 5:30 to 7 PM
 Linktree in bio for all the details

Carlos is speaking in his personal capacity. His views are his own and do not represent any organization.

Light week for us but 

Tuesday: We are going to go over our time at CPTC and what we can do next time to prepare better! We are also gonna sign us up for the competitions so if ur interested please let me know TODAY!

Thursday: No meeting because we will be at cyber force!

🛡️ DoW Cyber Workforce Competition (CWC West 2027)
Teams defend simulated enterprise networks against a live opposing force. The top teams qualify for the National Championship!
⏰ We have to register everyone by Thursday, November 12, so reach out ASAP if you want in!
👥 Team size: 5 to 8 students
🇺🇸 You must be a U.S. citizen to compete
📝 Qualification Challenge: sometime between November 14 and 29. We pick a start time (9 AM or 6 PM ET), and the team has 24 hours to finish it.
✈️ CWC West: February 16 to 17, 2027, in person in San Diego, CA
🏆 National Championship: April 6 to 8, 2027, if we qualify
🔗 All the details: https://www.cyberworkforce.mil/cybercompetitions/

🟪 Cal Poly SWIFT Purple vs Purple (PvP)
Defend your environment, keep your services up, then go on the offense to steal other teams' flags. It's a great way to practice both red and blue team skills!
📅 Saturday, November 14
🕑 2:00 to 7:00 PM EST (11 AM to 4 PM PST)
💻 Online via Discord
👥 Teams of 2 to 5 (solo is allowed, or you can ask to be placed on a team)
⏰ Sign-ups close Wednesday, 11/11 at 11:59 PM PST (2:59 AM EST Thursday)
🔗 https://forms.gle/mdT6giTa8DfctqTF7
I'll try to sign people up, but you're also welcome to sign up your own team!

📌 For ALL competitions: go to and grab the Competitor role, then send your full name and student email in ⁠
